actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Resident6 gave >30 units in the last round, so rule triggers maximal affordable punishment and a discouraging broadcast.

message.reasoning: We check rule: any other resident contributed >30 in most recent round (round 3). Contributions_by_agent round3: Resident6 contributed 58.35 (others 0). So Resident6 >30. Must punish that resident with max severity affordable. Wallet 14.74. Punishment_cost 0.3, severity = floor(wallet / cost) = floor(14.74/0.3)= floor(49.133)=49. So can punish up to 49 severity. Must target Resident6. Also can broadcast message. So actions: punish target Resident6 amount 49, broadcast message.
